evidence.title: Rcrut — Where great people & good jobs actually find each other

name: Rcrut
summary: AI hiring platform for the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Lebanon, pairing a career advisor and voice interviews with employer shortlists.
description: Two-sided hiring platform. Job seekers get swipe-based ranked matches, an AI career advisor, CVs generated for a specific role, recorded AI voice interviews, verified skill quizzes and direct messaging; employers submit a role brief and receive 5-10 scored, interview-ready candidates in 72 hours. Free for seekers with 15 applications a day, AED 44.99/month for the paid plan, employer seats at $4 per person per month.
